headers.//: Default everything to revalidate. cleanUrls strips the .html from the request path, so a rule matching **/*.html never fires on /study/maths/exam-questions or on / - which left every page cached for an hour and kept users on the previous bundle after each deploy. Matching ** instead is the only glob that reaches an extensionless route. The long-lived exceptions are re-granted below, because Firebase applies matching header blocks in order and the last one to set a key wins.
Safe to cache forever: the build puts a content hash in every filename, so a changed file is a different URL.
